items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: Joe and Steve, they helped me. And that's how I learned to play the piano... Steve was a great piano player... he helped Joe Robichaux and Joe Robichaux helped me.

ctx.x: I knew. Yes. If you wanted... We can turn off for a minute. We're talking about your brother, your oldest brother Edwin.
Yes, who was helping me with what he knew. And he told me to go over and see Steve Lewis. And she asked Steve would he help me. And they also knew Joe Robichaux. Oh, yeah.
I just rode the bus down at the Joe Robichaux.
